definitions.lots: Gross per possession transfer; recapturing a previously lost lot begins a new episode. A captured lot is released when it passes to an enemy worker, enemy cash, or unclaimed ground. Enemy tree tax reduces carried lots pro rata using the exact simulator deduction. Cash credited upon collision and subsequent banking are distinguished.
definitions.defensive_denominator: collector with >=50 cargo; exposed when staying is reachable by an enemy collector of lower or equal cargo; safe landing excludes enemy bases and such enemy reach, without assuming future enemy commands.
